verdict.rationale: Open WebUI officially documents install paths via pip, uv, Docker, and Kubernetes (kubectl, kustomize, helm), plus bare metal, and its quick start pulls and runs the Docker image. That covers the Docker and Kubernetes/Helm targets, but the evidence does not show a separate maintained guide for each target. missing for 10: an explicit Docker Compose guide, dedicated small-VPS and Raspberry Pi deployment guides, evidence that each path has its own maintained guide, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, official deployment paths cover my target — Docker Compose, Kubernetes/Helm, a small VPS, or a Raspberry Pi — each with its own maintained guide
